row_grain.bhp: one retained official BHP report-inventory row (qxfy-wcfs)
row_grain.srt: one retained official SRT report-inventory row (h54t-xnbi)

missing_value: CSV empty cell / JSON null for absent numbers or dates. Zero remains zero. String absence is empty string.
date_policy: Only valid YYYY-MM-DD dates are parsed; the original text is always kept in the matching _text column.
unit_policy: Units come from the ODP field-name suffix unless an entry cites an official document. Values are shown as reported; psia and psig are kept as labelled and never converted.
window: Exact uic_no; not limited to the reporting period.

documents.name: srt-guidelines.html
documents.supports: SRT purpose, fracture (parting) pressure, fracture gradient in psi/ft, ISIP recorded at shut-in, stepped injection rates

documents.name: bhp-permian-nto.pdf
documents.supports: BHP method and unit, p.1; Permian districts 7C, 8, 8A and Fisher County only; states "Operator shall report pressure (PSIG)"

not_cited: Form W-7 (oil and gas wells, not UIC), conference slides and the versioned review spreadsheet are not used as evidence.

source_row_key.definition: Dataset snapshot plus 1-based raw response ordinal; retained duplicates stay distinct

parent_key.definition: Inventory source_record_key when the exact uic_no string matches exactly one retained inventory parent (ADR 004 inventory_to_test_report)

parent_join_status.definition: matched / unmatched / ambiguous by exact UIC string

uic_number.definition: Original nine-character uic_no; preserves leading zeros

source_report_id.definition: Original report_id kept as a string; part of the report identity
source_report_id.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. Identity value; meaning undocumented.

tracking_no.definition: Original tracking_no kept as a string; part of the report identity
tracking_no.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. Identity value; meaning undocumented.

test_sequence_no.definition: Original test_sequence_no kept as a string; part of the BHP report identity
test_sequence_no.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. Identity value; meaning undocumented.

report_conducted_date.definition: report_conducted_date when it is a valid YYYY-MM-DD date; otherwise empty

report_conducted_date_text.definition: Original report_conducted_date text exactly as published

report_received_date.definition: report_received_date when it is a valid YYYY-MM-DD date; otherwise empty

report_received_date_text.definition: Original report_received_date text exactly as published

bhp_psia.units: psia as named by the ODP field
bhp_psia.definition: Reported bottom hole pressure as published
bhp_psia.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. Official RRC Permian guidance (bhp-permian-nto.pdf p.1) states BHP is reported in PSIG; the ODP field name says psia. The conflict is unresolved; the value is shown as published and never converted. That guidance covers Permian districts 7C, 8, 8A and Fisher County only.

test_depth_ft.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. Reported depth; depth basis unstated (measured or true vertical depth is not documented).

gradient_psi_ft.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. Meaning unstated; not the SRT fracture gradient.

source_snapshot_id.definition: Dataset ID plus raw response SHA256 prefix

srt_received_date.definition: srt_received_date when it is a valid YYYY-MM-DD date; otherwise empty

srt_received_date_text.definition: Original srt_received_date text exactly as published

test_date.definition: test_date when it is a valid YYYY-MM-DD date; otherwise empty

test_date_text.definition: Original test_date text exactly as published

satisfactory_test_code.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. Values 0/1 shown verbatim; code meaning undocumented.

top_perf_ft.definition: Reported top perforation depth as published
top_perf_ft.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. Depth basis unstated.

bottom_perf_ft.definition: Reported bottom perforation depth as published
bottom_perf_ft.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. Depth basis unstated.

min_inj_rate_bpm.definition: Reported minimum step injection rate as published
min_inj_rate_bpm.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. Concept per official RRC step rate test guidelines (srt-guidelines.html); units from the ODP field name.

max_inj_rate_bpm.definition: Reported maximum step injection rate as published
max_inj_rate_bpm.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. Concept per official RRC step rate test guidelines (srt-guidelines.html); units from the ODP field name.

isip_psig.definition: Reported instantaneous shut-in pressure as published
isip_psig.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. Concept per official RRC step rate test guidelines (srt-guidelines.html); units from the ODP field name. The guidance records ISIP at both the surface and the bottom hole; which one this column holds is unstated.

formation_frac_press_psig.definition: Reported formation fracture (parting) pressure as published
formation_frac_press_psig.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. Concept per official RRC step rate test guidelines (srt-guidelines.html); units from the ODP field name.

frac_inj_rate_capacity_bpd.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. FIRC is not defined in any RRC document found; meaning unverified. Units from the ODP field name.

surface_pressure_firc_psig.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. FIRC is not defined in any RRC document found; meaning unverified. Units from the ODP field name.

fracture_gradient_psi_ft.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. Concept per official RRC step rate test guidelines (srt-guidelines.html); units from the ODP field name.

comments.note: ODP publishes no column descriptions. Verbatim text; meaning undocumented.
